title: Compute wave speeds
action: Determine the isotropic elastic constants of EAM-Ni along the [001] direction and compute the longitudinal (c_L), transverse (c_t), and Rayleigh (c_R) wave speeds.
description: Rayleigh wave speed c_R needed to normalize crack-tip velocities and time.

title: Build strip model and equilibrate at Griffith load
action: Construct a thin-strip fcc Ni slab with a (100)[001] crack, apply fixed-displacement top/bottom boundaries and ramped viscous damping, then relax the system at boundary displacements corresponding to the Griffith energy release rate G0 (equilibrium at near-zero temperature).
description: Stationary equilibrated crack ready for overloading.

title: Run crack propagation simulations at overloads
action: For each overload G/G0 = 1.00, 1.02, 1.04, 1.10, 1.30, 1.50, 2.00, instantaneously rescale atomic displacements to apply the overload and run MD under constant energy release rate, with local viscous damping, logging crack-tip position at intervals.
description: Raw trajectories for velocity and instability analysis.

title: Steady-state velocities
action: Extract the terminal steady-state crack-tip velocity (normalized by c_R) from the overload runs at G/G0 = 1.04, 1.10, 1.30, 1.50 and write a CSV file.
description: Terminal steady-state velocities for overloads above lattice-trapping threshold.

title: Crack state at low overloads and branching at high overload
action: Classify whether the crack remains stationary or moves during the low overload simulations (G/G0 = 1.00, 1.02, 1.04) and also determine whether branching occurs at high overload 2.00 G0. Write a CSV file with columns: overload (float), state (string). Include rows for 1.00, 1.02, 1.04, 2.00.
description: Motion state near Griffith load and branching indicator at 2.00 G0.

title: Time trace at G=1.04G0
action: Output the crack-tip velocity vs time for the 1.04 G0 overload run as a CSV file.
description: Velocity time series to verify acceleration to a steady plateau near the minimal steady speed.

title: Time trace at G=1.10G0
action: Output the crack-tip velocity vs time for the 1.10 G0 overload run as a CSV file.
description: Velocity time series to verify acceleration to a steady plateau around 0.4 c_R.
